purpose: SSH/apt UTF-8 and dialog support for the next distinct Ubuntu candidate
rules: Do not persist LC_ALL or DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive system-wide.
Use noninteractive only for unattended package commands.
Interactive SSH must request a real PTY and pass a supported TERM.
Require matching custom locales and libc-bin package versions; no stock libc replacement.
Preserve /etc/default/locale compatibility with PAM via the package symlink to /etc/locale.conf.
Supply current device hostname to the next base recipe and reconcile its local hosts alias after vendor hostname selection.
Frozen base/runtime artifacts remain unchanged; recomposition must update package closures explicitly.
validation: locale charmap UTF-8 with empty stderr for all three locales
